modules.source:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# System Monitor: the board, live. Linux on the Cortex-A7 (cores, memory, temperature, network)
# and what serves machine: the Cortex-M4 (firmware, channel, how long a request takes there and
# back), or on a board without one Linux's drivers (the classes, their devices, an ADC reading's
# time through the kernel).

import lvgl as lv

from probes import HARDWARE, MCU, probes

CORE_COLOURS = (0xE0742F, 0xE5C04C, 0xD9534F, 0xB07CE0)

_ui = None
_cpu_series = []
_net_series = []
_net_peak = 10.0
_ticks = 0


def _clean(chart):
    series = chart.get_series_next(None)
    while series:
        chart.remove_series(series)
        series = chart.get_series_next(None)
    chart.set_style_size(0, 0, lv.PART.INDICATOR)
    chart.set_style_line_width(2, lv.PART.ITEMS)
    chart.set_style_border_width(0, 0)
    chart.set_style_line_color(lv.color_hex(0x2A3444), lv.PART.MAIN)


def _duration(seconds):
    seconds = int(seconds)
    return "%dd %02d:%02d" % (seconds // 86400, seconds // 3600 % 24, seconds // 60 % 60)


def tick():
    # Every second; the M4's round trips every five.
    global _ticks, _net_peak
    _ticks += 1
    try:
        cores = probes.cpu()
        total, used = probes.memory()
        temperature = probes.temperature()
        network = probes.network()
    except OSError as error:
        _ui.linux_stats.set_text("Error: %s" % error)
        return
    while len(_cpu_series) < len(cores):  # one line for each core the board has
        colour = CORE_COLOURS[len(_cpu_series) % len(CORE_COLOURS)]
        _cpu_series.append(_ui.cpu_chart.add_series(lv.color_hex(colour), lv.chart.AXIS.PRIMARY_Y))
    for series, busy in zip(_cpu_series, cores):
        _ui.cpu_chart.set_next_value(series, int(busy))
    small = _small()
    if small:
        _ui.cpu_label.set_text("CPU  " + "  ".join("%.0f%%" % b for b in cores))
    else:
        _ui.cpu_label.set_text("CPU  " + "   ".join("core %d %3.0f%%" % (i, b) for i, b in enumerate(cores)))
    rx = sum(r for r, t in network.values())
    tx = sum(t for r, t in network.values())
    _net_peak = max(10.0, _net_peak * 0.98, rx, tx)
    _ui.net_chart.set_axis_range(lv.chart.AXIS.PRIMARY_Y, 0, int(_net_peak * 1.1))
    _ui.net_chart.set_next_value(_net_series[0], int(rx))
    _ui.net_chart.set_next_value(_net_series[1], int(tx))
    if small:
        _ui.net_label.set_text("NET  in %.1f  out %.1f kB/s" % (rx, tx))
    else:
        _ui.net_label.set_text("NETWORK  in %.1f kB/s   out %.1f kB/s   (scale %d kB/s)" % (rx, tx, _net_peak * 1.1))
    lines = ["memory %d of %d MB used" % (used, total), "temperature %.1f C" % temperature,
             "load %s   up %s" % (probes.load(), _duration(probes.uptime()))]
    lines += ["%s  in %.1f  out %.1f kB/s" % (name, r, t) for name, (r, t) in sorted(network.items())][:2 if small else 3]
    _ui.linux_stats.set_text("\n".join(lines))
    _ui.memory_bar.set_value(100 * used // max(1, total), False)
    if _ticks % 5 == 1 and not MCU:
        try:
            board, devices, trips = probes.kernel()
            text = "\n".join("%s  %s" % (name, device) for name, device in devices)
            if trips:
                trips.sort()
                if small:
                    text += "\nADC read: %d us (max %d)" % (trips[len(trips) // 2], trips[-1])
                else:
                    text += "\n\nan ADC reading through the kernel:\nmedian %d us, slowest %d" % (trips[len(trips) // 2], trips[-1])
            _ui.m4_stats.set_text(text)
        except OSError as error:
            _ui.m4_stats.set_text("Error: %s" % error)
    elif _ticks % 5 == 1:
        try:
            state, firmware, channel, trips = probes.m4()
            trips.sort()
            if small:
                _ui.m4_stats.set_text("%s\n%s\nover %s\nround trip: median %d us\nfastest %d, slowest %d"
                                      % (state, firmware, channel, trips[len(trips) // 2], trips[0], trips[-1]))
                return
            _ui.m4_stats.set_text(
                "%s, %s\nover %s\n\na request there and back\n(20 of them, every 5 s):\nmedian %d us   fastest %d   slowest %d"
                % (state, firmware, channel, trips[len(trips) // 2], trips[0], trips[-1]))
        except OSError as error:
            _ui.m4_stats.set_text("Error: %s" % error)


def start(ui):
    global _ui
    _ui = ui
    lv.screen_active().set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(0x121820), 0)
    for chart in (ui.cpu_chart, ui.net_chart):
        _clean(chart)
        chart.set_point_count(60)
    ui.cpu_chart.set_axis_range(lv.chart.AXIS.PRIMARY_Y, 0, 100)
    _net_series.append(ui.net_chart.add_series(lv.color_hex(0x4C8DFF), lv.chart.AXIS.PRIMARY_Y))
    _net_series.append(ui.net_chart.add_series(lv.color_hex(0x4CC38A), lv.chart.AXIS.PRIMARY_Y))
    host = "simulator"
    if HARDWARE:  # in the simulator /proc would be the PC's
        try:
            host = open("/proc/sys/kernel/hostname").read().strip()
        except OSError:
            pass
    if _small():
        ui.host.set_text(host)
    else:
        ui.host.set_text("%s    cores orange, yellow, ...    in blue, out green" % host)
    if not MCU:
        import mpy_board

        ui.m4_title.set_text("MACHINE ON LINUX" if _small() else "MACHINE ON LINUX'S DRIVERS")
        ui.linux_title.set_text("LINUX ON %s" % mpy_board.describe().get("board", "THE BOARD").upper())
    tick()


def _small():
    return lv.display_get_default().get_vertical_resolution() < 400
